topRootCauses.downstreamEffect: FLUX filled the unallocated void with a spurious Flat 04; vision detected 4 flats

topRootCauses.rootCause: Zero-tolerance collision checking (<0mm) on shared 115mm/230mm partition walls in detectRoomCollisions
topRootCauses.downstreamEffect: Generated 12-16 false-positive overlap errors across adjacent rooms sharing a wall line

topRootCauses.rootCause: Uncoordinated independent lift lobbies in Core generator
topRootCauses.downstreamEffect: Double lobby footprint (36m² vs 18m²), stranding Flat 02 entrance without legal corridor connection

topRootCauses.rootCause: Missing mandatory room schedule enforcement in 3BHK program
topRootCauses.downstreamEffect: Unit was generated with only 2 bedrooms, silently degrading 3BHK to 2BHK

topRootCauses.rootCause: Prompt lacking hard architectural contract header
topRootCauses.downstreamEffect: FLUX interpreted reference images with 4-6 flats as permission to subdivide floor plate
